---
title: "Ohlone Greenway"
---

The Ohlone Greenway is a Class I (fully separated) bicycle and pedestrian path running the full length of El Cerrito, beneath the BART tracks.

## Ohlone Greenway Downtown Improvements

A funded capital project in the current biennial budget:

| Fiscal Year | State Grant Funding |
|---|---|
| FY2028 | $126,300 |
| FY2029 | $1,053,000 |
| **Total** | **$1,179,300** |

::: {.source-note}
Source: FY2026-27/FY2027-28 Biennial Budget, State Grant (secured) funding table.
:::

## Relevance to Richmond Street

Richmond Street runs roughly three blocks east of, and parallel to, the Ohlone Greenway for most of its length. See [Richmond Street & Complete Streets](richmond-street.qmd) for the funding history of bike lanes on that separate, largely redundant corridor.

## Related: Crosstown Connect

A separate, newly documented project: an east-west bikeway connecting Ashbury Avenue and the San Francisco Bay Trail via Downtown and the El Cerrito Plaza BART station, planned in collaboration with Public Works.

| Fiscal Year | State Grant Funding |
|---|---|
| FY2027 | $225,000 |
| FY2028 | $45,000 |
| FY2029 | $565,000 |
| FY2030 | $565,000 |
| FY2031 | $565,000 |
| **Total** | **$1,965,000** |

::: {.source-note}
Source: FY2026-27/FY2027-28 Biennial Budget, State Grant (secured) funding table; Community Development Department accomplishments.
:::
